issue.title: Lib test executable stubs exec with ETXTBSY under parallel cargo test --lib
issue.description: Lib-test executable stubs (fake curl, fake listen scripts, ref-job kick scripts) are written in place with fs::write, so a concurrently forked test thread can make their exec fail with ETXTBSY under parallel `cargo test --lib`. bob-cli-o fixed the identical race only for the tests/cli helpers.

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by phase bead bob-cli-5k.2 (note #1, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) during epic bob-cli-5k; triaged by bob-cli-5k.land.

- On athena, 2026-10-07, 2 of 26 default-parallel full `cargo test --lib` runs failed a `native::highlights_ref::fetch::tests` case with `Text file busy (os error 26)` when exec-ing a just-written, unique-path `fake-curl.sh`.
- 0 of 20 base runs failed, and 0 of 20 isolated fetch-loop runs failed.
- bob-cli-5k.land then ran 2 `just check` passes and 5 `cargo test --lib` runs on master 74c2afc (load ~76-82) without a recurrence.
- The failure needs other test threads forking at the same moment, so it shows up only under full-suite parallel load.

Root cause: this is the same ETXTBSY race that bob-cli-o fixed for the CLI-side helpers only.
- Lib test helpers write the stub in place with `fs::write` and then `set_permissions`. Examples: `write_fake_curl` in `src/native/highlights_ref/fetch.rs` (~line 364), `write_executable` in `src/native/highlights_ref/listen.rs` (~line 699), and `write_executable` in `src/native/ref_jobs/kick.rs` (~line 185).
- While the writable fd is open, another test thread can `fork`. The child inherits the fd until its own `exec` closes it (O_CLOEXEC).
- If this thread `exec`s the stub inside that window, the kernel refuses with ETXTBSY.

Fix: lib tests have no shared stub writer, so give them one that applies bob-cli-o's pattern.
- The pattern lives in `tests/cli/support.rs` `write_executable` (~line 473): write a scratch payload, then `cp` it onto a fresh inode, so the test process never holds a writable fd on the executed path.
- Route every lib-test executable stub writer through it. Also audit `src/native/gkeep/{pull,adapter}.rs` tests.
- Optionally port bob-cli-o's `executable_stubs_stay_executable_while_other_threads_fork` regression test.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: for i in $(seq 26); do cargo test --lib -- --test-threads=64; done

issue.creation_reason: Phase bob-cli-5k.2 saw fetch fake-curl exec fail with Text file busy 2x in 26 full lib runs; bob-cli-o's fork-safe stub writer covers only the CLI test helpers, so the lib-side race remains.

payload.description: bob-cli-o fixed the same fork/writable-fd ETXTBSY race for tests/cli helpers only; reuse its scratch+cp writer
proposed by bob-cli-5k.2 note #1 during env-isolation stress runs

evidence.note: Independent repro during bob-cli-5k landing (2026-10-07, athena): native::ref_jobs::kick::tests::kicked_child_leaves_session_and_stdio failed under just check load with Text file busy (os error 26) exec-ing the just-written fake-bob.sh probe script, and passed in isolation (0.16s). Same in-place stub-write race; kick.rs is in this bead's listed scope.
